messages:
anne: Quick intake — vendor RedLeaf wants to run an external pen test next week against staging and a small slice of prod dataflow. Scope callout: KMS-wrapped artifacts, temporary RBAC role elevation for assessors, and audit log exports. Need ops + infra signoff and retest window.

mike: @anne thanks. Who is the main contact at RedLeaf? We need the assessor IPs, expected tooling (nmap/burp/xc), and whether they need console access or just API endpoints. :memo:

anne: Contact is claire@redleafsec.com. They asked for ephemeral console role for 2h on day-of to validate UI flows. Primary tooling is Burp + custom fuzzers. They also want sample log exports.

luca: On RBAC: we can create an ephemeral role via our idp with 2h TTL, but need a changelog entry + approval from infra. Also: do we want to gate which resources are in scope via resource tags? Strongly recommend tagging staging namespace 'pt-scope=true' and attaching policy that only allows read+exec, no write to production buckets.

jess: Audit log question — they'll ask for queryable logs for timeline. We can export a 30d slice of CloudTrail + application audit logs. But the retention window for our debug logs is 90d behind a paid tier; are we pulling full logs or just the subset?

sam: KMS: can't hand over keys. We can create per-engagement data key (DEK) encrypted under a customer-scoped CMK with an allowlist for the assessment role. Alternatively generate presigned artifacts for them to download. Which do we prefer?

anne: Preference is DEK rotate + ephemeral grant. RedLeaf requested that we not hand them long-term access.

mike: OK. Docs we need: 1) scope matrix (hosts, APIs, creds, tooling), 2) RBAC change ticket with rollback plan, 3) audit export runbook, 4) KMS evidence package. I'll own the RBAC ticket. @luca can you own KMS plan?

luca: I'll own KMS + DEK flow. Plan: create DEK, encrypt artifacts, create ephemeral grant via KMS Grant API with expiry. We should document commands. Example presigned S3 download snippet we give assessors for evidence pull:

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/pack-2026-03-28.tar.gz --expires-in 3600
```

And KMS grant example (pseudo):

```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-2026 --grantee-principal arn:...:assessor-role --operations Encrypt Decrypt --constraints {"EncryptionContextSubset": {"pt-id":"redleaf-2026"}}
```

jess: For audit exports I'll create a trimmed query that pulls user, action, resource, ip, and timestamp. We'll hash user identifiers where possible for privacy. Also prepping a CSV export format for assessors.

ops-bot: scheduled: staging-maintenance-window at 2026-03-29T02:00Z (duration 3h). Please confirm if RBAC changes should occur inside this window.

anne: Yes, let's do the role swap + grant provisioning during that window to limit blast radius. Staging only; no prod flips.

mike: Retest coordination — RedLeaf asked for two retest slots: immediate (24–48h) after remediation and a final retest one week later. Proposed: initial retest 2026-03-30 10:00-14:00 UTC, final 2026-04-06 09:00-12:00 UTC. Anyone conflicts?

sam: Those windows look fine from infra side. Need a pre-run checklist: 1) snapshot logs, 2) freeze deployments for 2h prior, 3) ensure metrics alerts muted. I'll drop the checklist into the ticket.

jess: Add to checklist: ensure SIEM ingest continues but suppression rules applied for noise. We should also tag assessors' IP ranges for alert suppression.

luca: One more KMS note: after retest, revoke the grant keys and rotate the DEK. Also export the grant audit trail (ListGrants/ListRetireGrant) for evidence.

anne: Action items recap: 
- mike: open RBAC change ticket + rollback plan (due EOD today)
- luca: write KMS DEK + grant runbook + example commands (due tomorrow)
- jess: produce audit export query + CSV template (due tomorrow)
- sam: infra checklist & mute plan (due EOD)
- anne: coordinate assessor intake (ips/creds) and confirm retest booking (today)

mike: I'll create the ticket now and ping legal for the NDA addendum. cc: @jess @luca

anne: Thanks all. I'll confirm RedLeaf on the retest windows and post assessor IPs when I have them. :thumbsup:

sam: FYI we'll need to limit ephemeral role session policies to: sts:AssumeRole, s3:GetObject (evidence bucket), logs:DescribeExportTasks, kms:Decrypt with constraint on EncryptionContext. Keep it minimal.

jess: Noted. tagging this thread with #pen-test-intake for visibility.

mike: Closing loop — ticket created: ENGSEC-2147. I'll update with RBAC policy diff.

anne: Thread closed for now, will reopen if RedLeaf requests console access extension.
